raw_response:
I am 76 years old. I never went to school, I cannot read. Last year was my first year farming this land myself. Before that I worked outside in construction for 50 years. My son is in Shijiazhuang, so I came back to the village. I have 5.5 mu. I plant 4 mu with wheat and then maize, like everyone here. The other 1.5 mu I plant cotton. My wife helps me but we are both old and slow.

I do not know much about farming, so I do exactly what my neighbor Lao Zhang does. He is 65 and has farmed his whole life. Last year I copied him and I did not starve, so this year I will do the same.

For wheat: After the maize comes off in autumn, I hire the rotary tiller. I sow improved wheat seed, 30 jin per mu. For fertilizer I put down one full bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base — that is 50 kg per mu. In March when the wheat turns green I spread another 30 jin of urea per mu. I know fertilizer costs a lot, but Lao Zhang says using too little is dangerous. I would rather waste some fertilizer than lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster. I irrigate three times from my well: once before winter, once when the stems grow fast, and once when the grain is filling. I spray medicine three times. Last year I got 800 jin per mu. I hope for 800 jin again this year.

For maize: After wheat harvest in early June there is no time to plough. I hire the machine to plant hybrid seed directly with no-tillage. One package per mu. I put compound fertilizer in the planting holes, about 40 jin per mu. When the maize is knee-high I topdress with urea, about 25 jin per mu. I irrigate two times in summer. I spray three times for bugs and weeds. Last year I got 1000 jin per mu. I expect 1000 jin this year.

For cotton: Cotton is hard work but the price was good last year. In April I plough the 1.5 mu deep. I sow improved cotton seed, 3 jin per mu. I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu and some extra potassium fertilizer. My cousin told me cotton needs more potassium. I water two times. Cotton has many bugs — bollworms, aphids. I will spray six times. Last year I picked 400 jin of seed cotton per mu. I hope for the same.

I do everything based on what I saw last year and what Lao Zhang does. I do not trust new varieties or new methods. I am 76. Change is too risky. Every jin of fertilizer costs real money, but losing the crop costs more. I watch my neighbors. If they buy more fertilizer this year, I will find the money to buy more too.
